name: Mexican Tomato Soup (Sopa de Fideo) with Pasta, Avocado & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
3 medium carrots
⅓ kg green beans
1 ½ avocados
1 lime

instructions.primary_message: Peel and large dice onions. Large dice tomatoes; place both in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and roughly chop garlic.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onions, tomatoes, garlic, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat. (Reserve bowl for next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup butter, unsalted
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and cut green beans into 1-inch pieces. Place both in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Working in batches if necessary, transfer the tomato-onion mixture to a blender and blend on high until smooth; set aside.
Use your hands to break the pasta into 1-inch pieces.
Return pot to the stove over medium-high heat; add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the pasta and cook, stirring constantly, until it turns golden, 2-3 minutes.

Add tomato-onion pureé, broth, tomato sauce, carrots, green beans, and spices to the pot. Stir to combine, bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and cover the pot. Simmer, stirring occasionally, until pasta and vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp cumin, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add peas to the soup during the last 2-3 minutes of cooking; continue to simmer until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados; scoop out flesh with a spoon and medium dice.
Divide soup between bowls; top with avocado and feta. Serve with lime wedges on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
